# CLI reference

Every `bob` command, generated from the same help text `bob --help` prints.

## Daily workflow

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`bob capture`](capture.md) | Capture tasks, bullets, and Pomodoro commands into the vault |
| [`bob freshness`](freshness.md) | Walk the tiered freshness review queue |
| [`bob plan`](plan.md) | Show today's plan budget, Today's tasks, and NEXT/PENDING lanes |
| [`bob pomodoro`](pomodoro.md) | Show Pomodoro status, print the tmux line, or notify on completion |
| [`bob pomodoro notify`](pomodoro.md#bob-pomodoro-notify) | Notify when the current Pomodoro is complete |
| [`bob pomodoro status`](pomodoro.md#bob-pomodoro-status) | Show the current Pomodoro status (default) |
| [`bob pomodoro tmux`](pomodoro.md#bob-pomodoro-tmux) | Print the Pomodoro status and plan meter for tmux |
| [`bob ready`](ready.md) | Show each area/project note's Ready lane against the per-note cap |
| [`bob stats`](stats.md) | Show derived daily metrics as a glance, detail chart, or catalog |
| [`bob stats metrics`](stats.md#bob-stats-metrics) | List metric ids, kinds, and definitions |
| [`bob stats overview`](stats.md#bob-stats-overview) | Show the weekly glance (default) |
| [`bob stats show`](stats.md#bob-stats-show) | Show one or more metrics in detail |

## Tasks and projects

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`bob projects`](projects.md) | List and sync project notes via their ^prj tasks |
| [`bob task`](task.md) | Vault-wide task maintenance: archive, move, reconcile, reroll |
| [`bob task archive`](task.md#bob-task-archive) | Move done and canceled tasks into done/ archives and repair links |
| [`bob task move`](task.md#bob-task-move) | Move open tasks between notes and repair vault links |
| [`bob task reconcile`](task.md#bob-task-reconcile) | Reconcile task statuses from the Pomodoro ledger and dependencies |
| [`bob task reroll`](task.md#bob-task-reroll) | Re-roll due prioritized tasks within their priority windows |

## Vault

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`bob articles`](articles.md) | Format and inspect article notes with bob-owned section numbers |
| [`bob nightly`](nightly.md) | Run nightly maintenance: vault-sync, task archive, articles, vault-sync |
| [`bob query`](query.md) | Run Dataview or Tasks queries against the vault |
| [`bob ref`](ref.md) | Find, list, read, rename, and plan references for today; sync Highlights PDFs into them |
| [`bob vault-sync`](vault-sync.md) | Reconcile the vault through Git (default: run) or show status |

| Command | What it does |

## Capture protocol

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`bob capture-complete`](capture-complete.md) | Complete the capture marker at the cursor |
| [`bob capture-parse`](capture-parse.md) | Explain what in-progress capture text currently means |
| [`bob capture-pomodoro-name`](capture-pomodoro-name.md) | Write a name onto an open unnamed Pomodoro |
| [`bob capture-pomodoros`](capture-pomodoros.md) | List today's Pomodoro ledger entries |
| [`bob capture-related`](capture-related.md) | List existing tasks that a new capture may duplicate |
| [`bob capture-rewrite`](capture-rewrite.md) | Apply the capture grammar's automatic draft rewrites |
| [`bob capture-sections`](capture-sections.md) | List the non-Tasks sections of a capture note |
| [`bob capture-targets`](capture-targets.md) | List inbox, area, and active project capture routes |
| [`bob capture-task-id`](capture-task-id.md) | Write a block ID onto an open capture task |
| [`bob capture-task-sections`](capture-task-sections.md) | List the ALL-CAPS child sections of a capture task |
| [`bob capture-tasks`](capture-tasks.md) | List the open tasks of a capture note |
| [`bob capture-templates`](capture-templates.md) | List, save, show, and manage saved capture templates |
| [`bob capture-templates clear`](capture-templates.md#bob-capture-templates-clear) | Clear the saved-template shelf |
| [`bob capture-templates delete`](capture-templates.md#bob-capture-templates-delete) | Delete templates by list index or content id |
| [`bob capture-templates list`](capture-templates.md#bob-capture-templates-list) | List saved capture templates (default) |
| [`bob capture-templates save`](capture-templates.md#bob-capture-templates-save) | Save a template definition without capturing a row |
| [`bob capture-templates show`](capture-templates.md#bob-capture-templates-show) | Print one template as a ready-to-insert draft |

## Full help

```text title="bob --help"
Bob tracks a daily Pomodoro ledger inside an Obsidian vault and keeps that
vault synced through Git. Commands follow the daily workflow: capture, review
(plan, freshness, ready), stats, run Pomodoros, reconcile tasks, and nightly
maintenance. Pass `--help` to any command, or run `bob help <command>`, for
its own options.

Usage: bob <COMMAND>

Daily workflow:
  capture     Capture tasks, bullets, and Pomodoro commands into the vault
  freshness   Walk the tiered freshness review queue
  plan        Show today's plan budget, Today's tasks, and NEXT/PENDING lanes
  pomodoro    Show Pomodoro status, print the tmux line, or notify on completion
  ready       Show each area/project note's Ready lane against the per-note cap
  stats       Show derived daily metrics as a glance, detail chart, or catalog

Tasks and projects:
  projects    List and sync project notes via their ^prj tasks
  task        Vault-wide task maintenance: archive, move, reconcile, reroll

Vault:
  articles    Format and inspect article notes with bob-owned section numbers
  nightly     Run nightly maintenance: vault-sync, task archive, articles,
              vault-sync
  query       Run Dataview or Tasks queries against the vault
  ref         Find, list, read, rename, and plan references for today; sync
              Highlights PDFs into them
  vault-sync  Reconcile the vault through Git (default: run) or show status

Integrations:
  gkeep       Drain the Google Keep inbox into Obsidian tasks

Setup:
  completion  Install and inspect shell completion for bob
  plugins     List and deploy Bob's custom Obsidian plugins

Capture protocol:
  capture-complete       Complete the capture marker at the cursor
  capture-parse          Explain what in-progress capture text currently means
  capture-pomodoro-name  Write a name onto an open unnamed Pomodoro
  capture-pomodoros      List today's Pomodoro ledger entries
  capture-related        List existing tasks that a new capture may duplicate
  capture-rewrite        Apply the capture grammar's automatic draft rewrites
  capture-sections       List the non-Tasks sections of a capture note
  capture-targets        List inbox, area, and active project capture routes
  capture-task-id        Write a block ID onto an open capture task
  capture-task-sections  List the ALL-CAPS child sections of a capture task
  capture-tasks          List the open tasks of a capture note
  capture-templates      List, save, show, and manage saved capture templates

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

Examples:
  bob capture buy milk @groceries   Capture a task into groceries.md
  bob capture '='                   Start the queued Pomodoro
  bob plan                          Show today's plan budget and lanes
  bob freshness                     List the review queue
  bob ready                         Show Ready lanes against the per-note cap
  bob stats                         Glance at derived daily metrics
  bob task reconcile --dry-run      Preview task status reconciliation
  bob query --source '#project'     Print matching note paths
  bob vault-sync status --json      Print the last vault Git sync status

Run 'bob <command> --help' or 'bob help <command>' for more on a command.
```
